claims.explanation: Nocodazole is a microtubule-depolymerizing agent that arrests cells in mitosis; selectivity likely reflects how efficiently cells arrest and then die after a prolonged mitotic block, which depends on spindle-assembly-checkpoint strength and mitotic/anti-apoptotic signaling. Lines with intact checkpoint signaling and high mitotic or anti-apoptotic tone (e.g., TP53-mutant, BRAF/PTEN-mutant, or KRAS-driven lines) appear more sensitive, whereas lines with EGFR/MAP2K1 activation or neuroblastoma identity are relatively protected. The transcriptional signature (down CDK1, TOP2A, UBE2C; up AURKA) and similarity to other tubulin inhibitors support a mitotic-spindle mechanism rather than an HPGDS-mediated effect.

features.basis: TP53-mutant lines dominate the sensitive set and are largely absent from the protected set, consistent with impaired post-mitotic checkpoint arrest after spindle damage
BRAF-mutant melanoma and other BRAF-mutant lines are enriched among sensitive lines, suggesting MAPK-driven mitotic dependency
PTEN loss appears in several sensitive lines (WM793, HDQP1, ZR751, HEC265, UACC62), consistent with PI3K/AKT-mediated mitotic survival signaling
KRAS-mutant pancreatic and colorectal lines are enriched in the sensitive set, suggesting RAS-driven mitotic dependency
EGFR-mutant lung lines (HCC4006, KYSE270, NCIH1650) are mostly in the protected set, suggesting EGFR signaling supports survival during mitotic arrest
NCIH1437 (MAP2K1-mutant) is among the least affected lines, suggesting constitutive MEK/ERK signaling protects against nocodazole
ALK-mutant neuroblastoma and mesothelioma lines (SKNSH, KELLY, NCIH2452) are in the protected set, suggesting ALK-driven survival signaling
AURKA is upregulated in the virtual-cell response and Aurora kinases govern mitotic spindle assembly and checkpoint function
CDK1 is strongly downregulated in the virtual-cell response, indicating cells engage a mitotic-arrest transcriptional program after nocodazole
TOP2A is downregulated in the virtual-cell response and topoisomerase II function is required at mitosis, linking it to nocodazole sensitivity
UBE2C is downregulated in the virtual-cell response and is a mitotic ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme required for spindle checkpoint progression
BECN1 is upregulated in the virtual-cell response, suggesting autophagy induction may buffer mitotic catastrophe
